capsule.repacking: Deterministic ZIP; prefix removed; each of the 24 original member bodies preserved byte-for-byte.

limitations: One dated baseline, not a two-date comparison.
Curated selection; not representative coverage or a popularity ranking.
Raw decoded JSON entities retained; compressed wire bodies not retained.
Source checks verify internal agreement, not independent authentication of upstream origin.
No move/delete/restore history, resolved QID mapping or pageview continuity.

rights.scope: Factual Wikipedia page metadata and observed Wikidata identifiers only; no article prose or images. API access is not a licence to other content.

source.omitted: m1-title discovery bundle and m1-run-receipt.json; original title-discovery claims are not independently revalidated by this retained subset
